login.title: Sign in
login.description: Sign in with your email and password.

mfa.description: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.

enroll.description: Your account requires a second factor. Use an authenticator app (TOTP).

enroll.recovery.description: They are your last resort if you lose the app. Each one works once and will not be shown again.

invitation.passwordHelp: At least 12 characters. A long phrase beats a short password full of symbols.

strength.privacy: Checked in your browser; the password is never sent to any third party.
